name: Stacked
description: Three framed crack-screen panels become a stack of books — orange, blue and green covers with white titles that carry green and violet colour fringes — with an open book resting on top.
choices: The thick single-colour frames and white type of early hi-res title cards become book covers and spine titles
Colour fringes on every white edge mimic how hi-res white picks up green and violet; nothing is lettered
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
